summary: Verified the dark mode toggle bug fix on Home Shred app. Toggle now correctly switches the theme across all screens (Settings, Today, Week, History), persists across reload via localStorage 'homeshred:settings', shows Sonner toasts ('Light mode on' / 'Dark mode on'), and no regressions observed. All acceptance criteria from the review request are met.

test_results_detail.after_toggle_light: data-theme=light, body bg rgb(250,250,250), toast 'Light mode on' shown
test_results_detail.toggle_back_to_dark: data-theme=dark, body bg rgb(5,5,5), toast 'Dark mode on'
test_results_detail.reload_persistence_light: PASS - stays light after hard reload
test_results_detail.reload_persistence_dark: PASS - stays dark after hard reload
test_results_detail.regressions: None observed. History chart shows a benign recharts warning about width(-1)/height(-1) during tab transition, but chart renders. Bottom nav retains orange active accent in both themes.

critical_code_review_comments: Recharts prints width/height warnings on History tab initial render — not blocking, but consider giving ResponsiveContainer a fixed minHeight to silence it.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dark mode toggle fix verified end-to-end on mobile viewport 420x900. data-theme attribute correctly flips on <html>, CSS overrides in index.css apply light palette across all tabs, and localStorage key 'homeshred:settings' persists { darkMode: boolean, restSeconds: number }.
rca of the issue: Original bug: Settings toggle was local-only state, never applied to <html>. Fix confirmed working: theme state lifted to App.js, applied as data-theme on <html>, CSS mappings in index.css handle every hardcoded dark hex.
